title: STRONG
description: STRONG is a placeholder EEG dataset formatted according to BIDS with HED annotations. The README provides no detailed description of the participants, task, or experimental content. The dataset is mirrored from an OpenNeuro deposit.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired and preprocessed according to BIDS standards. The dataset includes EEG recordings with associated event markers and channel information. Data are provided in EEGLAB format (.set/.fdt) with BIDS-compliant JSON sidecars and TSV event files.
